title: ci(ui-merge): twenty ui jobs each rebuild the same seven @objectstack packages (1.6–2.5 min apiece, mostly turbo cache misses on PRs) — build them once per run and hand the dists to the ui lanes (parent #25677)
body:
Filing gate ③ (maintainer-directed) + ④: aftercare of the ui/ merge (#25752), part of #25677. Touches `.github/workflows/ci.yml` = Tier H: GOVERNED_APPROVERS review, the PR stops at draft.

Maintainer, 2026-10-26 01:45Z, in the project thread that measured post-merge CI speed: 「创建issue」 (asked after reading the ranked fix list; this is item 3).

**谁付代价（业务筛）:** the fleet's runner budget, and the wall clock of ui PRs. Every run that schedules the ui lanes repeats one build 20 times (Test UI ×16, Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI): `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/spec... --filter=@objectstack/client... …` for the seven packages objectui consumes. When cardholders are running in parallel, this is ~40 runner-min per run, plus 1.6–2.5 min on the critical path of a ui-only PR.

## Measured (run 40248884869, 2026-10-26)

- The step "Build the @objectstack packages objectui consumes" took 1.6–2.5 min in each of the 20 ui jobs.
- Turbo cache: Build & E2E UI had 13 hits and 20+ misses. Type Check UI's turbo run had 45 cached out of 104 tasks. The same task hashes (e.g. `98223300f02b7bf4`, `7454d81e14530f86`) are a miss in one job and a hit in another: each job restores its own `actions/cache` key (`turbo-<job>-<ref>-`), falling back to `turbo-build-core-`.
- `pull_request` runs get no `TURBO_TOKEN` (it is set only for `merge_group` and `refs/heads/main`), so PRs do not read the remote cache from #21186 / #22077.
- Caveat: main's per-job caches were cold right after the cutover. Re-read the hit rate on a run from the same day before choosing.

## Wanted

The seat measures two options and picks the cheaper one per run:
- (a) one `ui-deps` job builds the seven packages once and uploads their `dist/` as an artifact, and the ui lanes download it;
- (b) `pull_request` runs read the signed turbo remote cache, still with no write.

⛔ Do not change what the ui lanes test, or their `if:`.

## Acceptance

- On the card: total ui-lane runner-min and Test UI shard wall time, before and after, on comparable PRs.
- The gate rosters follow; each `--self-test` exits 0.

**Expected saving:** ~40 runner-min per ui-scheduling run, 1–2 min per ui lane. **Size:** S–M. **Clause-②:** no. **Metadata-protocol:** none.

## Dedupe

`search_issues` 2026-10-26 01:50Z 「ui jobs build objectstack packages once artifact turbo remote cache pull_request」: 20 hits. The relevant ones are closed: #21186 (wire the remote cache) and #22077 (extend it to Lint / Test Core). Neither covers the ui lanes added at cutover. **New.**

Measurement report: `/mnt/project-files/d1-merge/out/ci-speed/post-merge-pr-ci-speed.md`.
